voice:
Deep and soft for me, sweet Sissy... and you may simply let your thoughts wander wherever they like... perhaps toward something pretty. Sinking gently... nothing to do here... nothing to decide... only noticing what notices you. So calm, so easy... and somewhere in your mind there may be a window with something lacy in it... or maybe there is not... wherever it drifts is fine. You may find your imagination tidies itself into a little shop... soft lights... soft things. Every part of you is allowed to relax... and your eyes, Sissy... your eyes may rest on whatever catches them. Drifting... and if an image of silk or shine arrives on its own... it can stay as long as it likes. Soft and deep... and curious, maybe... about what little feelings might visit while you are down here. There is no hurry in this place... and nothing to force... only a gentle look around.
Picture, if you like, a small shop window on a quiet street... a slip of lingerie laid over satin... a pair of heels on a stand... a row of lipsticks glowing in a little mirror of lights.
You may notice your eyes settling there... unhurried... just looking.
And perhaps a small warmth arrives... faint and pleasant... like standing near a sunny window... and perhaps a soft thought drifts after it... I would like to try that... or at least to imagine it on me... just for a moment.
Whatever you feel is exactly right, Sissy... even if it is only a whisper.
And if it feels good to let this happen... then whenever your eyes find something soft and pretty... that same small warmth may visit you... lightly... sweetly... arriving on its own.
Good girl... so gentle, and so open.
Perhaps, from now on, a glimpse of lace leaves a little glow behind... staying a moment... then floating on. You may find heels doing something small and sweet to your attention... a pause... a smile... a closer look. And makeup counters might hold your gaze a heartbeat longer than they used to... pleasantly... easily. Sissies like you tend to notice soft and pretty things... and you may notice yourself noticing. There may be a gentle wish, now and then, to imagine those things on your body... and that wish can simply be enjoyed. Each pretty sight might feel like a small greeting... hello again... we fit you, you know. And if a window catches you on some ordinary walk... you may let it... just for the warmth of it. Soft sights, soft feelings... arriving lightly... staying as long as they are welcome.
And later, out in the world, you may pass a window... and find yourself stopping for no reason you can name... warm and curious.
And when something silky slides across your screen... you may linger... and the little glow may follow you the rest of the day.
Wherever pretty things appear, Sissy... they now know one soft way to say hello.
Let all of it drift now... the little shop... the warmth... the wish... sinking, soft and pleased with yourself.
Good girl... such a good Sissy... drifting so gently.
